read.thesis: PPG returned to organic growth (Q1 sales $3.7B, -4% reported) with EPS guide $7.75–$8.05 reaffirmed, but no supply-side discipline evidence; Mexico project pause and auto softness offset by share gains and self-help.

triggers.label: US organic sales up 4% after six quarters
triggers.quote: In the U.S., after 6 quarters of declines or flat performance, we achieved 4% organic sales growth

triggers.label: Mexico project spending paused
triggers.quote: a pause in project-related business and governmental spending in Mexico due to recent geopolitical related uncertainty

triggers.label: Architectural EBITDA margin down 310 bps
triggers.quote: Segment EBITDA margin decreased 310 basis points versus prior year

triggers.label: EPS guide $7.75–$8.05 reaffirmed
triggers.quote: We are reaffirming a full-year earnings per share guidance range of $7.75 to $8.05.

guidance.quote: We are reaffirming a full-year earnings per share guidance range of $7.75 to $8.05.
segment margins to be up 50 basis points for the full year
